description:
Report in-content citations of a moving artifact that carry a `:line` or `:line:column` suffix, such as `` `dev/active/<dir>/plan.md:119` ``, as `moving-path-citation` warnings, so an archive preview names every citation the relocation would break.

## Background

- The archive contract reports, and does not rewrite, in-content citations a relocation would break: a preview and an execution emit `moving-path-citation` warnings read from the declared `citation_scan_roots` (`docs/reference/cli-commands.md`, archive section).
- A citation counts only when the text after the moving path is a citation end (`is_citation_end`, `crates/jit/src/domain/artifact_classifier.rs`): end of text, a delimiter from `is_citation_delimiter`, or a sentence period. `:` is not a delimiter, so `plan.md:119` reads as a longer path and reports nothing.
- A container preview over `f4d9502a` warns for `` `dev/active/9db27a3a-v1-0/handoff-2026-10-23-codex.md` `` cited without a suffix in `dev/active/df129d9e-rust-code-quality/handoff-10.md`, but reports none of the suffixed citations of the moving `dev/active/f4d9502a-git-cli-module/plan.md`, `breakdown.json` and `investigation.md` in `dev/active/0f8efc37-frontends-share-core/investigation.md` (for example line 22, `plan.md:119`) and `dev/active/f368ce3d-domain-agnostic-engine/investigation.md` (line 73).
- Repository-relative paths cannot contain `:`: `RootRelativePath::parse` (`crates/jit/src/domain/relative_path.rs`) refuses it, so a `:` directly after a whole moving path cannot extend it into another repository path.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A moving path followed by `:` and one or more digits (optionally `:` and more digits) is a whole-path citation and earns one `moving-path-citation` warning at the citation's line and column.
- [hard] REQ-02: Text naming a longer path that ends with the moving path still reports nothing, and the existing citation fixtures pass unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-03: Unit tests in the classifier own the `path:line` and `path:line:column` cases and a negative case, and a command test shows a preview warning for a `path:line` citation in a scanned file; both fail on the code this issue starts from.
- [hard] REQ-04: The archive section of `docs/reference/cli-commands.md` states that a citation may carry a `:line` or `:line:column` suffix.

## Notes

- Rewriting citations in other files is outside the archive contract; this issue only makes the advisory warnings complete.
- Found by a preview of the completed epic `f4d9502a`; no archive run happened.
title: Archive citation scan misses path citations with a line suffix
